resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

entity.use_en: A one-harvest forage plant containing emergency calories. It cannot support a renewable farm, so treat it as an exploration reserve.
entity.use_zh: 一次收穫的覓食植物，提供緊急熱量；不能形成可再生農場，應視為探索備糧。

resources.use_en: A one-harvest forage plant containing emergency calories. It cannot support a renewable farm, so treat it as an exploration reserve.

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
resources.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Refine into aluminum, an excellent heat-conducting metal for radiant pipes, metal tiles and thermal machinery.
resources.use_zh: 可精煉成鋁；鋁導熱優秀，適合輻射管、金屬磚與熱能設備。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water and dirt to grow lumber branches. Lumber becomes ethanol, power, polluted water and carbon dioxide, enabling a renewable industrial loop.
entity.use_zh: 消耗汙水與泥土長出木材；木材可轉為乙醇、電力、汙水與二氧化碳，形成可再生工業循環。

resources.use_en: Consumes polluted water and dirt to grow lumber branches. Lumber becomes ethanol, power, polluted water and carbon dioxide, enabling a renewable industrial loop.
resources.use_zh: 消耗汙水與泥土長出木材；木材可轉為乙醇、電力、汙水與二氧化碳，形成可再生工業循環。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

entity.use_en: A one-harvest forage plant containing emergency calories. It cannot support a renewable farm, so treat it as an exploration reserve.
entity.use_zh: 一次收穫的覓食植物，提供緊急熱量；不能形成可再生農場，應視為探索備糧。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: A one-harvest forage plant containing emergency calories. It cannot support a renewable farm, so treat it as an exploration reserve.
resources.use_zh: 一次收穫的覓食植物，提供緊急熱量；不能形成可再生農場，應視為探索備糧。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

entity.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.
entity.use_zh: 容易栽種的早期作物，消耗泥土並產出米虱；需要複製人勞動且食物品質低，泥土成為瓶頸前應轉型。

entity.use_en: Consumes dirt, water and carbon dioxide to emit oxygen. It is useful early but scales poorly because fixed planting spots and fertilizer demand constrain output.

resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

entity.use_en: Consumes phosphorite, cools nearby gas and emits radiation in Spaced Out. Use it for spot cooling or radbolts, but provide fertilizer and radiation protection.

resources.use_en: Consumes phosphorite, cools nearby gas and emits radiation in Spaced Out. Use it for spot cooling or radbolts, but provide fertilizer and radiation protection.

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.

resources.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.

resources.use_en: Melts into polluted water, a source of irrigation, coolant and filtered water. It can release germs and should be melted in a controlled basin.

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.

entity.use_en: Grows without fertilizer in chlorine and produces Balm Lily Flowers for medical packs. Its chlorine atmosphere is the main setup requirement.
entity.use_zh: 在氯氣中生長且不需肥料，產出香水百合花供醫療包；主要建置要求是氯氣環境。

resources.use_en: Grows without fertilizer in chlorine and produces Balm Lily Flowers for medical packs. Its chlorine atmosphere is the main setup requirement.
resources.use_zh: 在氯氣中生長且不需肥料，產出香水百合花供醫療包；主要建置要求是氯氣環境。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Kills exposed germs, supports Dasha Saltvines and some ranching chains, and preserves food atmospheres. It is unbreathable and does not disinfect material inside pipes or solid tiles.
resources.use_zh: 可殺死暴露其中的病菌，供沙鹽藤及部分牧場鏈使用，也能作食物保存氣氛。不可呼吸，且不會消毒管內物質或實心磚內部。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

entity.use_en: Grazes suitable plants, produces phosphorite and can be sheared for Reed Fiber; Glossy morphs yield plastic. Hydrogen regrows scales, while plants require their own gas and temperature zones.
entity.use_zh: 啃食適合植物並產磷礦，可剪取蘆葦纖維；滑鱗變種可產塑膠。鱗片需氫氣再生，而植物另有氣體與溫度需求。

resources.use_en: Grazes suitable plants, produces phosphorite and can be sheared for Reed Fiber; Glossy morphs yield plastic. Hydrogen regrows scales, while plants require their own gas and temperature zones.
resources.use_zh: 啃食適合植物並產磷礦，可剪取蘆葦纖維；滑鱗變種可產塑膠。鱗片需氫氣再生，而植物另有氣體與溫度需求。

resources.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
resources.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

entity.use_en: A low-maintenance decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It does not generate food, oxygen, power or radiation.
entity.use_zh: 低維護裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；不生產食物、氧氣、電力或輻射。

resources.use_zh: 低維護裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；不生產食物、氧氣、電力或輻射。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water and phosphorite in a warm environment to grow Pincha Peppernuts for advanced recipes. Heat is helpful here but irrigation must remain stable.
entity.use_zh: 在溫暖環境中消耗汙水與磷礦，產出火椒果供進階料理；高溫在此有利，但灌溉必須穩定。

resources.use_en: Consumes polluted water and phosphorite in a warm environment to grow Pincha Peppernuts for advanced recipes. Heat is helpful here but irrigation must remain stable.
resources.use_zh: 在溫暖環境中消耗汙水與磷礦，產出火椒果供進階料理；高溫在此有利，但灌溉必須穩定。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

entity.use_en: Grows without fertilizer in chlorine and produces Balm Lily Flowers for medical packs. Its chlorine atmosphere is the main setup requirement.
entity.use_zh: 在氯氣中生長且不需肥料，產出香水百合花供醫療包；主要建置要求是氯氣環境。

resources.use_en: Grows without fertilizer in chlorine and produces Balm Lily Flowers for medical packs. Its chlorine atmosphere is the main setup requirement.
resources.use_zh: 在氯氣中生長且不需肥料，產出香水百合花供醫療包；主要建置要求是氯氣環境。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Kills exposed germs, supports Dasha Saltvines and some ranching chains, and preserves food atmospheres. It is unbreathable and does not disinfect material inside pipes or solid tiles.
resources.use_zh: 可殺死暴露其中的病菌，供沙鹽藤及部分牧場鏈使用，也能作食物保存氣氛。不可呼吸，且不會消毒管內物質或實心磚內部。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

entity.use_en: Grazes suitable plants, produces phosphorite and can be sheared for Reed Fiber; Glossy morphs yield plastic. Hydrogen regrows scales, while plants require their own gas and temperature zones.
entity.use_zh: 啃食適合植物並產磷礦，可剪取蘆葦纖維；滑鱗變種可產塑膠。鱗片需氫氣再生，而植物另有氣體與溫度需求。

resources.use_en: Grazes suitable plants, produces phosphorite and can be sheared for Reed Fiber; Glossy morphs yield plastic. Hydrogen regrows scales, while plants require their own gas and temperature zones.
resources.use_zh: 啃食適合植物並產磷礦，可剪取蘆葦纖維；滑鱗變種可產塑膠。鱗片需氫氣再生，而植物另有氣體與溫度需求。

resources.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
resources.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

resources.use_en: An effectively indestructible world boundary beneath geysers and map edges. It has no normal player production use and should be treated as terrain, not a harvest target.

resources.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
resources.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fire it with coal in a Kiln to make Ceramic, a strong insulation and high-temperature construction material. Deodorizers can renew clay from polluted oxygen and sand.
resources.use_zh: 可與煤炭在窯爐燒製陶瓷，供隔熱及高溫建築使用。除臭器能以汙氧與沙子持續產出黏土。

entity.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
entity.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Duplicants can breathe it, but it can carry Slimelung and irritants. Deodorize it into clean oxygen and clay, or feed Pufts where disease control is established.

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted oxygen and excretes slime, renewing algae and mushroom resources. Morph control depends on ranch gases and Puft Prince population.
entity.use_zh: 食用汙氧並排出軟泥，可再生藻類與蘑菇資源；變種控制取決於牧場氣體及帕夫王數量。

resources.use_en: Distill into algae and polluted water, or let it off-gas polluted oxygen. It can contain Slimelung; store submerged and process behind hygiene controls.
resources.use_zh: 可蒸餾成藻類與汙水，也會逸散汙氧。可能含黏液肺病菌，宜浸液儲存並在衛生管制下加工。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water and produces Reed Fiber for Atmo Suits, clothing and Insulation recipes. Farms are resource-hungry; wild plants are valuable.
entity.use_zh: 消耗汙水並產出蘆葦纖維，可製氣壓服、衣物與隔熱配方。人工種植耗水高，野生植株很有價值。

entity.use_en: A decorative plant whose floral scent can suppress other airborne germs, but the scent itself is a germ and may trigger allergies.
entity.use_zh: 裝飾植物，其花香可排擠其他空氣病菌，但花香本身也是病菌，可能引發過敏。

resources.use_en: A decorative plant whose floral scent can suppress other airborne germs, but the scent itself is a germ and may trigger allergies.
resources.use_zh: 裝飾植物，其花香可排擠其他空氣病菌，但花香本身也是病菌，可能引發過敏。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fire it with coal in a Kiln to make Ceramic, a strong insulation and high-temperature construction material. Deodorizers can renew clay from polluted oxygen and sand.
resources.use_zh: 可與煤炭在窯爐燒製陶瓷，供隔熱及高溫建築使用。除臭器能以汙氧與沙子持續產出黏土。

entity.use_en: Consumes slime in a carbon-dioxide atmosphere and yields mushrooms. It turns risky slime into good food, but farms need germ-safe slime handling.
entity.use_zh: 在二氧化碳中消耗軟泥並產出蘑菇，可把高風險軟泥轉成優良食物，但農場需要安全的病菌處理。

resources.use_en: Consumes slime in a carbon-dioxide atmosphere and yields mushrooms. It turns risky slime into good food, but farms need germ-safe slime handling.
resources.use_zh: 在二氧化碳中消耗軟泥並產出蘑菇，可把高風險軟泥轉成優良食物，但農場需要安全的病菌處理。

resources.use_en: Build machinery with a useful overheat-temperature bonus or refine it into gold for decor and refined-metal recipes. Ore availability is usually limited.
resources.use_zh: 製作機械時可提高過熱溫度，或精煉成金供裝飾與精煉金屬配方；礦量通常有限。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

entity.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
entity.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
resources.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Duplicants can breathe it, but it can carry Slimelung and irritants. Deodorize it into clean oxygen and clay, or feed Pufts where disease control is established.
resources.use_zh: 複製人可呼吸，但可能帶有黏液肺病菌及刺激物。可除臭成氧氣與黏土，或在妥善防疫後供帕夫食用。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses polluted oxygen, irrigates several crops and can be sieved into water. Control germs and heat before routing the output to food or oxygen systems.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散汙氧，可灌溉多種作物，也能過濾成水；輸往食物或製氧系統前需處理病菌與熱量。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted oxygen and excretes slime, renewing algae and mushroom resources. Morph control depends on ranch gases and Puft Prince population.
entity.use_zh: 食用汙氧並排出軟泥，可再生藻類與蘑菇資源；變種控制取決於牧場氣體及帕夫王數量。

resources.use_en: Consumes polluted oxygen and excretes slime, renewing algae and mushroom resources. Morph control depends on ranch gases and Puft Prince population.
resources.use_zh: 食用汙氧並排出軟泥，可再生藻類與蘑菇資源；變種控制取決於牧場氣體及帕夫王數量。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
resources.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

resources.use_en: Distill into algae and polluted water, or let it off-gas polluted oxygen. It can contain Slimelung; store submerged and process behind hygiene controls.

resources.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
resources.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

resources.use_en: Used with rust for oxygen, crushed into table salt for morale, and involved in saline processing. Desalinators provide a renewable stream when salt water or brine is renewable.

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

resources.use_en: A plentiful refined metal for automation, conductive wires and radiation shielding. Its very low melting point makes it unsafe near hot machinery.
resources.use_zh: 常見精煉金屬，適合自動化、導線與輻射屏蔽；熔點極低，不可用於高溫機械附近。

resources.use_en: An oil reservoir accepts water through an Oil Well to produce crude oil. It is a conditional point resource and releases hot natural gas during pressure relief.
resources.use_zh: 油田可透過油井注水產出原油；它是條件式點資源，洩壓時會釋放高溫天然氣。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

entity.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.
entity.use_zh:
惡魔花利用它們的花朵引誘沒有戒心的受害者到殭屍孢子雲中。

它們是一種罕見的全寄生植物，它找到哺乳動物宿主感染而不是普通的植物物種。

殭屍孢子最初設計用於藥用目的，但其鎮靜特性從未被提煉到有用的程度。

它們是一種罕見的全寄生植物，它找到哺乳動物宿主感染而不是普通的植物物種。

殭屍孢子最初設計用於藥用目的，但其鎮靜特性從未被提煉到有用的程度。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Refine into petroleum for power, plastic and rockets, or boil it for higher-yield petroleum. Oil systems produce heat and carbon-heavy byproducts.
resources.use_zh: 可精煉成石油，用於發電、塑膠與火箭；亦可加熱裂解以提高產率。原油系統會產生熱與含碳副產物。

resources.use_en: Consumed by drillcones and used for high-conductivity Tempshift Plates, Window Tiles and decor. Keep a reserve for space mining.
resources.use_zh: 鑽頭會消耗鑽石，也可製高導熱變溫板、窗戶磚與裝飾品；應為太空採礦保留庫存。

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

resources.use_zh: 常見精煉金屬，適合自動化、導線與輻射屏蔽；熔點極低，不可用於高溫機械附近。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

entity.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.

它們是一種罕見的全寄生植物，它找到哺乳動物宿主感染而不是普通的植物物種。

殭屍孢子最初設計用於藥用目的，但其鎮靜特性從未被提煉到有用的程度。

resources.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

resources.use_zh: 常見精煉金屬，適合自動化、導線與輻射屏蔽；熔點極低，不可用於高溫機械附近。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

resources.use_en: Kills exposed germs, supports Dasha Saltvines and some ranching chains, and preserves food atmospheres. It is unbreathable and does not disinfect material inside pipes or solid tiles.
resources.use_zh: 可殺死暴露其中的病菌，供沙鹽藤及部分牧場鏈使用，也能作食物保存氣氛。不可呼吸，且不會消毒管內物質或實心磚內部。

entity.use_en: Consumes chlorine gas and produces salt. It can reclaim chlorine and support rust oxygen or table-salt chains, but needs the correct gas atmosphere.
entity.use_zh: 消耗氯氣並產出鹽，可回收氯並支援鐵鏽製氧或食鹽鏈，但需要正確的氣體環境。

resources.use_en: Consumes chlorine gas and produces salt. It can reclaim chlorine and support rust oxygen or table-salt chains, but needs the correct gas atmosphere.
resources.use_zh: 消耗氯氣並產出鹽，可回收氯並支援鐵鏽製氧或食鹽鏈，但需要正確的氣體環境。

entity.use_en: Consumes chlorine gas and produces salt. It can reclaim chlorine and support rust oxygen or table-salt chains, but needs the correct gas atmosphere.

resources.use_en: Consumes chlorine gas and produces salt. It can reclaim chlorine and support rust oxygen or table-salt chains, but needs the correct gas atmosphere.
resources.use_zh: 消耗氯氣並產出鹽，可回收氯並支援鐵鏽製氧或食鹽鏈，但需要正確的氣體環境。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

resources.use_en: Common surface and space construction mineral. Use it as expendable bulk material where stronger decor, insulation or conductivity is unnecessary.
resources.use_zh: 常見於地表與太空的建築原礦；在不需要高裝飾、隔熱或導熱時可作消耗性大量建材。

entity.use_en: A cold crop irrigated with ethanol that produces Nosh Beans for cooking. It is powerful when ethanol and cooling are already sustainable.
entity.use_zh: 低溫作物，以乙醇灌溉並產出小吃豆供烹飪；在乙醇與冷卻已可持續時才特別划算。

resources.use_en: A cold crop irrigated with ethanol that produces Nosh Beans for cooking. It is powerful when ethanol and cooling are already sustainable.
resources.use_zh: 低溫作物，以乙醇灌溉並產出小吃豆供烹飪；在乙醇與冷卻已可持續時才特別划算。

resources.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
resources.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

resources.use_en: Feed a Rust Deoxidizer with salt to produce oxygen, chlorine and iron ore. The oxygen chain is finite unless rust is renewed through space or other sources.
resources.use_zh: 與鹽一起供除鏽機，可產生氧氣、氯氣與鐵礦。除非由太空或其他來源補充，這條製氧鏈屬有限資源。

resources.use_en: Used with rust for oxygen, crushed into table salt for morale, and involved in saline processing. Desalinators provide a renewable stream when salt water or brine is renewable.
resources.use_zh: 可與鐵鏽製氧，也可磨成食鹽提高士氣，並參與鹽水加工；若鹽水或濃鹽水可再生，淡化器能持續產鹽。

resources.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt and use directly for Waterweed or compatible Aquatic crops. Pumping and desalination add power and heat costs.
resources.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽，也可直接供水草或相容水族作物；抽水與淡化會增加耗電及熱量。

resources.use_en: Hot sour gas can be cooled into methane and sulfur for a high-output power chain, but the required temperatures and pressure control are advanced hazards.
resources.use_zh: 高溫酸氣可冷卻成天然氣與硫，形成高輸出的發電鏈；但所需溫度與壓力控制具有進階風險。

entity.use_en: Consumes chlorine and excretes bleach stone for Waterweed and sanitation chains. Stable chlorine supply and morph management are required.
entity.use_zh: 食用氯氣並排出漂白石，支援水草與消毒鏈；需要穩定氯源及變種管理。

resources.use_en: Consumes chlorine and excretes bleach stone for Waterweed and sanitation chains. Stable chlorine supply and morph management are required.
resources.use_zh: 食用氯氣並排出漂白石，支援水草與消毒鏈；需要穩定氯源及變種管理。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Grubfruit plants and feeds Sweetles/Grubgrubs, enabling sucrose and food production. Sulfur geysers can make this chain renewable.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥蟲果並餵甜素甲蟲／蟲果蟲，支援蔗糖與食物生產；硫泉可使此鏈再生。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Refined metal for machinery and the main metal input to steel. Reserve enough for steel before using large quantities in ordinary wiring or decor.
resources.use_zh: 精煉金屬，可製機械，也是鋼的主要金屬原料；大量用於一般電線或裝飾前應先保留製鋼量。

resources.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
resources.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.
entity.use_zh: 耐受性高的裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；沒有生產產物，但在適合溫壓範圍內容易維護。

entity.use_en: Consumes water and light to produce Bristle Berries for several quality foods. Lighting adds power and heat, so combine it with efficient lamps and cooling.
entity.use_zh: 消耗水與光照產出鬃刺莓，可製多種優質料理；照明增加耗電與熱，宜搭配高效率燈具及冷卻。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

resources.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.

entity.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.
entity.use_zh: 容易栽種的早期作物，消耗泥土並產出米虱；需要複製人勞動且食物品質低，泥土成為瓶頸前應轉型。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.

resources.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
resources.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
resources.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

resources.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
resources.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

entity.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.
entity.use_zh: 容易栽種的早期作物，消耗泥土並產出米虱；需要複製人勞動且食物品質低，泥土成為瓶頸前應轉型。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.
entity.use_zh: 耐受性高的裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；沒有生產產物，但在適合溫壓範圍內容易維護。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
resources.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
resources.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
resources.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.
entity.use_zh: 耐受性高的裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；沒有生產產物，但在適合溫壓範圍內容易維護。

entity.use_en: Consumes water and light to produce Bristle Berries for several quality foods. Lighting adds power and heat, so combine it with efficient lamps and cooling.
entity.use_zh: 消耗水與光照產出鬃刺莓，可製多種優質料理；照明增加耗電與熱，宜搭配高效率燈具及冷卻。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.

塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

entity.use_en:
The Bammoth is one of the oldest species on record, with ancient skeletal remains dating back approximately 10,000 years.

This placid herbivore is known for its unique body language: an angry young Bammoth expresses displeasure by flopping down dramatically in front of its opponent, while older creatures with limited mobility will sit facing away from the source of their annoyance.

Licking the ground in front of a caregiver can be a sign of either deep affection or mineral deficiency.
entity.use_zh:
猛瑪絨兔是有紀錄以來最古老的物種，其古老的遺骸可追溯到大約 10,000 年前。

這種平靜的食草動物因其獨特的肢體語言而出名：一隻憤怒的青年猛瑪絨兔會透過在對手面前戲劇性地摔倒表達不滿，而行動不便的年長猛瑪絨兔會背對著引起它煩惱的來源坐著。

在看護者面前舔舐地面可能是其深厚感情的表現，也可能是缺乏礦物質的表現。

resources.use_en: A naturally occurring luminous object in Cool Pool terrain. It provides light and decor and can be carved for stronger decorative value.

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

entity.use_en:
Plume Squashes contain over a dozen types of remarkably stable anthocyanins; twice the number found in any other plant. This high concentration of flavonoids contributes to the tuber's vivid pigmentation and tolerance to low temperatures.

The entire root is safe to eat, including the peel. The upper "plume" can be used to brush wayward bits off one's chin after the meal.
entity.use_zh:
羽葉果薯含有十幾種極其穩定的花青素；其含量是其他任何植物的兩倍。這種高濃度的類黃酮有助於該塊莖呈現鮮豔的色素沉著，並提升其耐低溫能力。

整個根部連同外皮都可安全食用。其上部的「羽狀物」則可用於飯後拂去下巴上的頑固碎屑。

entity.use_en:
The Bammoth is one of the oldest species on record, with ancient skeletal remains dating back approximately 10,000 years.

This placid herbivore is known for its unique body language: an angry young Bammoth expresses displeasure by flopping down dramatically in front of its opponent, while older creatures with limited mobility will sit facing away from the source of their annoyance.

Licking the ground in front of a caregiver can be a sign of either deep affection or mineral deficiency.
entity.use_zh:
猛瑪絨兔是有紀錄以來最古老的物種，其古老的遺骸可追溯到大約 10,000 年前。

這種平靜的食草動物因其獨特的肢體語言而出名：一隻憤怒的青年猛瑪絨兔會透過在對手面前戲劇性地摔倒表達不滿，而行動不便的年長猛瑪絨兔會背對著引起它煩惱的來源坐著。

在看護者面前舔舐地面可能是其深厚感情的表現，也可能是缺乏礦物質的表現。

entity.use_en:
The Alveo Vera's fleshy stems are dotted with small apertures featuring bidirectional valves through which Carbon Dioxide is absorbed and sticky oxygenated waste is secreted.

The buildup from this respiration cycle crystallizes into Oxylite ore.

Horticulturists have long been curious about the protective epithelium that prevents the Oxylite ore from sublimating while on the plant. Unfortunately, it is too fragile to survive handling, and has thus far proven impossible to study.
entity.use_zh:
多孔蘆薈的肉質莖上分佈著小孔，這些孔具有雙向閥膜，可以吸收二氧化碳並分泌黏性含氧廢物。

這種呼吸迴圈產生的分泌物最終會結晶成氧石。

園藝家長期以來都對其保護性的上皮細胞感到好奇，因為這種上皮細胞能防止植物上的氧石昇華。不幸的是，上皮細胞過於脆弱而無法承受任何方式的處理，因此到目前為止，研究也無法進行。

entity.use_en:
Evenly distributed throughout the Flox's dense overcoat are countless vibrissae-like hairs that transmit detailed sensory information about its environment, allowing it to detect changes as subtle as the shift in another creature's mood.

Floxes avoid overstimulation by whipping their tails to release the pent-up energy. Because these tactile hairs are so sensitive, they cannot be safely shorn.

Flox antlers, however, are nerveless and cumbersome. Handlers who unburden them of this cranial load are often rewarded with the critter's long, slow blinks of contentment.
entity.use_zh:
狐鹿克斯的濃密外層毛均勻分佈著無數觸鬚般的毛髮，能夠傳遞關於環境的感官資訊，

狐鹿克斯透過甩尾巴來釋放積壓的能量以避免過度刺激。由於這些觸覺毛髮非常敏感，所以不能安全地剪掉。

然而，狐鹿克斯角沒有神經連線並且很笨重。幫忙卸下頭角負擔的飼養員常常能獲得這種小動物因滿足而長久而緩慢的眨眼作為獎勵。

entity.use_en:
Idylla Flowers are a rare species of everblooms that thrive with very little care, making them a perennial favorite among newbie gardeners.

Their springy blossoms can be 'bopped' gently for sensory entertainment, but hands should be washed immediately as the petal residue can permanently stain most textiles.
entity.use_zh:
恬靜花是一種常開花的稀有物種，只需要非常少的照顧就能健康成長，使其常年成為新手園丁的最愛。

其富有活力的花可以輕輕地跳「博普舞」以帶來感官的娛樂，但之後應該立即洗手，因為花瓣殘留物能永久弄髒大多數紡織品。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

entity.use_en:
The Pikeapple Bush produces a nutritious fruit distantly related to those in the Durio genus.

Those who find the Pikeapple pulp's fragrance overwhelming should consume their portion whilst standing near the plant itself; the shrubbery's gentle swaying produces a wafting effect that promotes air circulation.

Closed-toe footwear is recommended, as barefoot contact with the plant's sharp seeds inevitably leads to infection.
entity.use_zh:
刺殼果灌木能產生一種營養豐富的果實，與榴槤屬的關係較遠。

那些發現刺殼果果肉的撲鼻香氣的人應當站在植株附近將其吃完；灌木輕微搖曳能產生一種吹拂效果，促進空氣流動。

建議穿不露腳趾的鞋，因為赤腳接觸這種植物的尖銳種子會不可避免地導致感染。

entity.use_zh: 雪漿果無法繁育，生長在原生冰錐內，只能作為一次性食物被收成。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Sherberries are incapable of propagating, but can be harvested for a single Food serving.
resources.use_zh: 雪漿果無法繁育，生長在原生冰錐內，只能作為一次性食物被收成。

resources.use_en: A cold-biome forage plant placed by worldgen features. Harvest it for early food, but do not count it as a renewable production chain.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的寒冷生態覓食植物，可供早期採集，但不能視為可再生生產鏈。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Mercury-bearing ore from cold regions; process it when mercury or its specialized low-temperature material properties are required.
resources.use_zh: 寒冷地區的含汞礦石；需要汞或其特殊低溫材料性質時再加工。

entity.use_en:
Evenly distributed throughout the Flox's dense overcoat are countless vibrissae-like hairs that transmit detailed sensory information about its environment, allowing it to detect changes as subtle as the shift in another creature's mood.

Floxes avoid overstimulation by whipping their tails to release the pent-up energy. Because these tactile hairs are so sensitive, they cannot be safely shorn.

Flox antlers, however, are nerveless and cumbersome. Handlers who unburden them of this cranial load are often rewarded with the critter's long, slow blinks of contentment.
entity.use_zh:
狐鹿克斯的濃密外層毛均勻分佈著無數觸鬚般的毛髮，能夠傳遞關於環境的感官資訊，

狐鹿克斯透過甩尾巴來釋放積壓的能量以避免過度刺激。由於這些觸覺毛髮非常敏感，所以不能安全地剪掉。

然而，狐鹿克斯角沒有神經連線並且很笨重。幫忙卸下頭角負擔的飼養員常常能獲得這種小動物因滿足而長久而緩慢的眨眼作為獎勵。

entity.use_en:
The Alveo Vera's fleshy stems are dotted with small apertures featuring bidirectional valves through which Carbon Dioxide is absorbed and sticky oxygenated waste is secreted.

The buildup from this respiration cycle crystallizes into Oxylite ore.

Horticulturists have long been curious about the protective epithelium that prevents the Oxylite ore from sublimating while on the plant. Unfortunately, it is too fragile to survive handling, and has thus far proven impossible to study.
entity.use_zh:
多孔蘆薈的肉質莖上分佈著小孔，這些孔具有雙向閥膜，可以吸收二氧化碳並分泌黏性含氧廢物。

這種呼吸迴圈產生的分泌物最終會結晶成氧石。

園藝家長期以來都對其保護性的上皮細胞感到好奇，因為這種上皮細胞能防止植物上的氧石昇華。不幸的是，上皮細胞過於脆弱而無法承受任何方式的處理，因此到目前為止，研究也無法進行。

狐鹿克斯透過甩尾巴來釋放積壓的能量以避免過度刺激。由於這些觸覺毛髮非常敏感，所以不能安全地剪掉。

然而，狐鹿克斯角沒有神經連線並且很笨重。幫忙卸下頭角負擔的飼養員常常能獲得這種小動物因滿足而長久而緩慢的眨眼作為獎勵。

resources.use_en:
Evenly distributed throughout the Flox's dense overcoat are countless vibrissae-like hairs that transmit detailed sensory information about its environment, allowing it to detect changes as subtle as the shift in another creature's mood.

Floxes avoid overstimulation by whipping their tails to release the pent-up energy. Because these tactile hairs are so sensitive, they cannot be safely shorn.

Flox antlers, however, are nerveless and cumbersome. Handlers who unburden them of this cranial load are often rewarded with the critter's long, slow blinks of contentment.

resources.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
resources.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

entity.use_en:
Idylla Flowers are a rare species of everblooms that thrive with very little care, making them a perennial favorite among newbie gardeners.

Their springy blossoms can be 'bopped' gently for sensory entertainment, but hands should be washed immediately as the petal residue can permanently stain most textiles.
entity.use_zh:
恬靜花是一種常開花的稀有物種，只需要非常少的照顧就能健康成長，使其常年成為新手園丁的最愛。

其富有活力的花可以輕輕地跳「博普舞」以帶來感官的娛樂，但之後應該立即洗手，因為花瓣殘留物能永久弄髒大多數紡織品。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

entity.use_en:
The Pikeapple Bush produces a nutritious fruit distantly related to those in the Durio genus.

Those who find the Pikeapple pulp's fragrance overwhelming should consume their portion whilst standing near the plant itself; the shrubbery's gentle swaying produces a wafting effect that promotes air circulation.

Closed-toe footwear is recommended, as barefoot contact with the plant's sharp seeds inevitably leads to infection.
entity.use_zh:
刺殼果灌木能產生一種營養豐富的果實，與榴槤屬的關係較遠。

那些發現刺殼果果肉的撲鼻香氣的人應當站在植株附近將其吃完；灌木輕微搖曳能產生一種吹拂效果，促進空氣流動。

建議穿不露腳趾的鞋，因為赤腳接觸這種植物的尖銳種子會不可避免地導致感染。

entity.use_en: Sherberries are incapable of propagating, but can be harvested for a single Food serving.
entity.use_zh: 雪漿果無法繁育，生長在原生冰錐內，只能作為一次性食物被收成。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Sherberries are incapable of propagating, but can be harvested for a single Food serving.
resources.use_zh: 雪漿果無法繁育，生長在原生冰錐內，只能作為一次性食物被收成。

resources.use_en: A cold-biome forage plant placed by worldgen features. Harvest it for early food, but do not count it as a renewable production chain.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的寒冷生態覓食植物，可供早期採集，但不能視為可再生生產鏈。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

entity.use_en:
The Alveo Vera's fleshy stems are dotted with small apertures featuring bidirectional valves through which Carbon Dioxide is absorbed and sticky oxygenated waste is secreted.

The buildup from this respiration cycle crystallizes into Oxylite ore.

Horticulturists have long been curious about the protective epithelium that prevents the Oxylite ore from sublimating while on the plant. Unfortunately, it is too fragile to survive handling, and has thus far proven impossible to study.
entity.use_zh:
多孔蘆薈的肉質莖上分佈著小孔，這些孔具有雙向閥膜，可以吸收二氧化碳並分泌黏性含氧廢物。

這種呼吸迴圈產生的分泌物最終會結晶成氧石。

園藝家長期以來都對其保護性的上皮細胞感到好奇，因為這種上皮細胞能防止植物上的氧石昇華。不幸的是，上皮細胞過於脆弱而無法承受任何方式的處理，因此到目前為止，研究也無法進行。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Mercury-bearing ore from cold regions; process it when mercury or its specialized low-temperature material properties are required.
resources.use_zh: 寒冷地區的含汞礦石；需要汞或其特殊低溫材料性質時再加工。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

那些發現刺殼果果肉的撲鼻香氣的人應當站在植株附近將其吃完；灌木輕微搖曳能產生一種吹拂效果，促進空氣流動。

建議穿不露腳趾的鞋，因為赤腳接觸這種植物的尖銳種子會不可避免地導致感染。

resources.use_en: A cold-biome forage plant placed by worldgen features. Harvest it for early food, but do not count it as a renewable production chain.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的寒冷生態覓食植物，可供早期採集，但不能視為可再生生產鏈。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

entity.use_en:
The Alveo Vera's fleshy stems are dotted with small apertures featuring bidirectional valves through which Carbon Dioxide is absorbed and sticky oxygenated waste is secreted.

The buildup from this respiration cycle crystallizes into Oxylite ore.

Horticulturists have long been curious about the protective epithelium that prevents the Oxylite ore from sublimating while on the plant. Unfortunately, it is too fragile to survive handling, and has thus far proven impossible to study.
entity.use_zh:
多孔蘆薈的肉質莖上分佈著小孔，這些孔具有雙向閥膜，可以吸收二氧化碳並分泌黏性含氧廢物。

這種呼吸迴圈產生的分泌物最終會結晶成氧石。

園藝家長期以來都對其保護性的上皮細胞感到好奇，因為這種上皮細胞能防止植物上的氧石昇華。不幸的是，上皮細胞過於脆弱而無法承受任何方式的處理，因此到目前為止，研究也無法進行。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Mercury-bearing ore from cold regions; process it when mercury or its specialized low-temperature material properties are required.
resources.use_zh: 寒冷地區的含汞礦石；需要汞或其特殊低溫材料性質時再加工。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

entity.use_en:
Evenly distributed throughout the Flox's dense overcoat are countless vibrissae-like hairs that transmit detailed sensory information about its environment, allowing it to detect changes as subtle as the shift in another creature's mood.

Floxes avoid overstimulation by whipping their tails to release the pent-up energy. Because these tactile hairs are so sensitive, they cannot be safely shorn.

Flox antlers, however, are nerveless and cumbersome. Handlers who unburden them of this cranial load are often rewarded with the critter's long, slow blinks of contentment.
entity.use_zh:
狐鹿克斯的濃密外層毛均勻分佈著無數觸鬚般的毛髮，能夠傳遞關於環境的感官資訊，

狐鹿克斯透過甩尾巴來釋放積壓的能量以避免過度刺激。由於這些觸覺毛髮非常敏感，所以不能安全地剪掉。

然而，狐鹿克斯角沒有神經連線並且很笨重。幫忙卸下頭角負擔的飼養員常常能獲得這種小動物因滿足而長久而緩慢的眨眼作為獎勵。

resources.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

entity.use_en:
Idylla Flowers are a rare species of everblooms that thrive with very little care, making them a perennial favorite among newbie gardeners.

Their springy blossoms can be 'bopped' gently for sensory entertainment, but hands should be washed immediately as the petal residue can permanently stain most textiles.
entity.use_zh:
恬靜花是一種常開花的稀有物種，只需要非常少的照顧就能健康成長，使其常年成為新手園丁的最愛。

其富有活力的花可以輕輕地跳「博普舞」以帶來感官的娛樂，但之後應該立即洗手，因為花瓣殘留物能永久弄髒大多數紡織品。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.

entity.use_en:
The Pikeapple Bush produces a nutritious fruit distantly related to those in the Durio genus.

Those who find the Pikeapple pulp's fragrance overwhelming should consume their portion whilst standing near the plant itself; the shrubbery's gentle swaying produces a wafting effect that promotes air circulation.

Closed-toe footwear is recommended, as barefoot contact with the plant's sharp seeds inevitably leads to infection.

resources.use_en: A massive heat source for steam-turbine geothermal power and igneous-rock production. Containment failures are catastrophic; use vacuum, insulated barriers and controlled heat exchangers.
resources.use_zh: 可供蒸汽渦輪地熱發電並產生火成岩。圍堵失敗後果嚴重，應使用真空、隔熱屏障與受控熱交換器。

resources.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
resources.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

entity.use_en:
The Bonbon Tree is a towering plant developed to thrive in below-freezing temperatures. It features multiple independently functioning branches that synthesize bright light to funnel nutrients into a hollow central core.

Once the tree is fully grown, the core secretes digestive enzymes that break down surplus nutrients and store them as thick, sweet fluid. This can be refined into Sucrose for the production of higher-tier foods, or used as-is to sustain Spigot Seal ranches.

Bonbon Trees are generally considered an eyesore, and would likely be eradicated if not for their delicious output.
entity.use_zh:
糖心樹是一種高聳的植物，可以在零下溫度中茁壯成長。它具有多個獨立運作的分枝，透過合成光線將營養物質彙集到中空的中心核中。

這種植物完全成熟後，核心部位就會分泌消化酵素，能將多餘的營養物質分解並以黏稠、甜蜜的液體形態儲存。這種液體可以提煉成蔗糖，用於生產更高階的食物，或直接用於維持栓角海豹養殖。

糖心樹通常被認為是有礙觀瞻，如果沒有美味的產出物，很有可能會被根除。

resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

entity.use_en:
Spigot Seals are named for the hollow, cone-shaped glabellar protrusion that allows them to siphon nourishment directly from plants into the digestive sac located at the cone's base.

In order to draw nutritious fluids through this "straw," the Spigot Seal compresses its nasal cavity and pumps its tongue up into its soft palate repeatedly, creating a vacuum.

Mealtimes are concluded by lapping at the air to reopen the airways and prevent accidental asphyxiation.

Many handlers enjoy teaching this critter to clap its flippers, only to discover that there is no reliable method of limiting how often or how loudly the behavior is repeated.
entity.use_zh:
栓角海豹因其中空的錐形眉間突起物而得名，這種結構能讓牠們直接從植物中吸取營養，流入位於錐形底部的消化囊中。

為了透過這根「吸管」吸取營養液，栓角海豹會壓緊鼻腔，並將舌頭反覆抽入其軟顎，形成真空。

進食結束時，透過快速舔食空氣重新開啟氣道，從而防止發生意外窒息。

許多飼養員喜歡教這種小動物拍打腳蹼，卻發現沒有可靠辦法限制這種行為的重複頻率和聲音大小。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: Refine into petroleum for power, plastic and rockets, or boil it for higher-yield petroleum. Oil systems produce heat and carbon-heavy byproducts.
resources.use_zh: 可精煉成石油，用於發電、塑膠與火箭；亦可加熱裂解以提高產率。原油系統會產生熱與含碳副產物。

resources.use_en: Consumed by drillcones and used for high-conductivity Tempshift Plates, Window Tiles and decor. Keep a reserve for space mining.
resources.use_zh: 鑽頭會消耗鑽石，也可製高導熱變溫板、窗戶磚與裝飾品；應為太空採礦保留庫存。

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

entity.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.
entity.use_zh:
惡魔花利用它們的花朵引誘沒有戒心的受害者到殭屍孢子雲中。

它們是一種罕見的全寄生植物，它找到哺乳動物宿主感染而不是普通的植物物種。

殭屍孢子最初設計用於藥用目的，但其鎮靜特性從未被提煉到有用的程度。

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en:
While other creatures with the Lumb's low forebrain neuron count rapidly become extinct, these docile creatures are uniquely positioned for survival.

Their large size and spiny protrusions make them unappealing to most predators. Anecdotal evidence also suggests that smaller species will sometimes adopt orphaned Lumbs.

Some experts theorize that this may be motivated by a desire to benefit from the Lumb's genetic muscular condition (akin to restless leg syndrome), which causes them to regularly pound the earth in such a way as to cause nearby plants to drop desirable foods.
entity.use_zh:
儘管其他前腦神經元數量稀少的生物會迅速滅絕，但豐足劍龍這種溫馴的生物卻具有獨特的生存優勢。

牠們龐大的體型和帶刺的突起，使其對大多數掠食者而言毫無吸引力。軼事證據也表明，較小的物種有時會收養孤兒豐足劍龍。

一些專家推測，這可能是為了從豐足劍龍的遺傳性肌肉病症（類似不寧腿症候群）中獲益，這種病症導致牠們規律地敲擊地面，從而使附近的植物掉落可口的食物。

entity.use_en:
Mimikas are difficult to categorize. Biologists theorize that the Mimika Bud engages in this rare variation of reproductive mimicry to improve seed-dispersal and survive the extinction of key species native to its original habitat.

These charming moth-like organisms feature a microscopic cluster of phytoprotein "brain" cells and are driven by a singular instinct to tend to their host plants.

Due to a monogenic malfunction, however, this plant-tending behavior benefits all of the flora in its area except its own.
entity.use_zh:
擬葉蛾難以分類。生物學家推測，擬葉蛾芽透過這種罕見的生殖擬態變異，來提升種子傳播效率，從而在其原生地一些關鍵物種滅絕後也能得以存活。

這些迷人的類蛾生物體內具有微小的植物蛋白「腦」細胞叢集，受一種奇異本能的驅動，會照料它們的宿主植物。

然而，由於單基因的缺陷，這種照料行為會使區域內自身以外的所有植物受益。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation or a world feature spawns this critter directly; the game defines no egg for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成或地圖特徵會直接生成此小動物；遊戲沒有為它定義蛋。

entity.use_en:
Mimika Buds are excellent companion plants that provide a farm with the advantages of beneficial insect presence without the challenges of managing an additional critter population.

Inside each tightly wrapped bud is a highly concentrated pool of enzymes and imaginal discs similar to those found in the Lepidoptera insect family.

Under the right conditions, this unique concoction produces a Mimika, an ephemeral pseudo-insect organism that accelerates growth in neighboring plants before settling into its final seed form.

The sight of a Mimika never fails to fill a gardener with awe.
entity.use_zh:
擬葉蛾芽是絕佳的伴生植物，能為農場帶來有益昆蟲的優勢，同時免去管理額外生物群體的挑戰。

每個緊密包裹的芽中都含有高濃度的酶和類似鱗翅目昆蟲的胚盤。

在適宜條件下，這種獨特的混合物將孕育出一隻擬葉蛾，這是一種短暫的類昆蟲生物，在最終化為種子形態之前，能顯著加速周邊植物的生長。

每當擬葉蛾現身，總能令園丁驚嘆不已。

entity.use_en:
Ovagros are resilient plants with highly efficient nutrient storage and redistribution systems. A healthy node produces many times the amount of energy that it requires. This is used to fuel the growth of exploratory vines that expand onto the surrounding territory.

Vines are entirely reliant on the node for nutrients. Each vine features hooked thorns that protect unripe fruit and act as crampons enabling the vine to use any empty surface as a trellis. They also make vine removal a tedious task.
entity.use_zh:
蔓殖藤是具有高效養分儲存和重新分配系統的彈性植物。一個健康的母藤產生的能量是其所需能量的許多倍。這些能量被用來驅動探索性藤蔓的生長，使其向周圍區域擴張。

藤蔓完全依賴母藤獲取養分。每根藤蔓都具有鉤狀的刺，可保護未成熟的果實，並作為攀岩釘，使藤蔓能夠利用任何空白表面作為支架。它們也使得移除藤蔓成為一項繁瑣的任務。

entity.use_en:
Snacti are fruit-bearing succulents whose DNA shows signs of having been crossed with an unnaturally formed fungi long ago.

The infestation is neither fatal nor contagious. It does, however, produce visible discoloration spots and fruit whose flavor is best described as "musty".
entity.use_zh:
食仙掌是會結果的多肉植物，其 DNA 顯示很久以前曾與非自然形成的真菌雜交過。

這種感染既不致命也不具傳染性。然而，它會產生可見的變色斑點，且果實的味道最好形容為「霉味」。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

entity.use_en:
The Sweatcorn Stalk is one of the oldest living members of the Zea genus.

This robust monopodial plant features eye-catching vegetable cobs prized for their color and intense sweetness.

Farmers gift the best of their harvest to their most valued neighbors. Some etymologists theorize that the term "corny" was coined to describe the heartfelt sentiments expressed in the accompanying card.
entity.use_zh:
津甜玉米稈是玉米屬現存最古老的成員之一。

這種堅韌的單軸植物，其引人注目的蔬菜玉米穗因其色彩和強烈甜味而備受珍視。

農民會將收成中最好的部分贈送給他們最珍視的鄰居。一些詞源學家推測，「老套」這個詞，正是為描述隨附卡片中所表達的真摯情感而創造的。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en:
While other creatures with the Lumb's low forebrain neuron count rapidly become extinct, these docile creatures are uniquely positioned for survival.

Their large size and spiny protrusions make them unappealing to most predators. Anecdotal evidence also suggests that smaller species will sometimes adopt orphaned Lumbs.

Some experts theorize that this may be motivated by a desire to benefit from the Lumb's genetic muscular condition (akin to restless leg syndrome), which causes them to regularly pound the earth in such a way as to cause nearby plants to drop desirable foods.
entity.use_zh:
儘管其他前腦神經元數量稀少的生物會迅速滅絕，但豐足劍龍這種溫馴的生物卻具有獨特的生存優勢。

牠們龐大的體型和帶刺的突起，使其對大多數掠食者而言毫無吸引力。軼事證據也表明，較小的物種有時會收養孤兒豐足劍龍。

一些專家推測，這可能是為了從豐足劍龍的遺傳性肌肉病症（類似不寧腿症候群）中獲益，這種病症導致牠們規律地敲擊地面，從而使附近的植物掉落可口的食物。
