resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: A cryogenic chlorine phase used mainly for storage or thermal designs before warming back into chlorine gas. It is extremely cold and phase changes can break pipes.
resources.use_zh: 氯的低溫液相，主要用於儲存或熱力設計，升溫後會成氯氣。溫度極低，發生相變時可能損壞管線。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Natural Gas Generators and an input to industrial gas handling. Ventilation and carbon-dioxide byproducts must be planned.
resources.use_zh: 天然氣發電機的燃料，也可用於工業氣體鏈；需規劃通風及二氧化碳副產物。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Burn in Hydrogen Generators, use in Drecko ranch atmospheres and liquefy for advanced rockets. It rises and is highly thermally conductive, so capture it above electrolyzers.
resources.use_zh: 可供氫氣發電機、龍鱗蜥牧場氣氛，並液化作進階火箭燃料。氫氣上浮且導熱高，宜在電解器上方收集。

entity.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
entity.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water and phosphorite in a warm environment to grow Pincha Peppernuts for advanced recipes. Heat is helpful here but irrigation must remain stable.

entity.use_en: Eats polluted dirt and rot piles, producing sand; molts provide shells for lime. Adults guarding eggs can attack duplicants, so isolate ranch traffic.
entity.use_zh: 食用汙土與腐爛堆並產沙；蛻殼可提供製石灰的殼。成體護卵時會攻擊複製人，牧場動線需隔離。

resources.use_en: Used with rust for oxygen, crushed into table salt for morale, and involved in saline processing. Desalinators provide a renewable stream when salt water or brine is renewable.
resources.use_zh: 可與鐵鏽製氧，也可磨成食鹽提高士氣，並參與鹽水加工；若鹽水或濃鹽水可再生，淡化器能持續產鹽。

resources.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt and use directly for Waterweed or compatible Aquatic crops. Pumping and desalination add power and heat costs.
resources.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽，也可直接供水草或相容水族作物；抽水與淡化會增加耗電及熱量。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
resources.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

entity.use_en: Eats polluted dirt and rot piles, producing sand; molts provide shells for lime. Adults guarding eggs can attack duplicants, so isolate ranch traffic.
entity.use_zh: 食用汙土與腐爛堆並產沙；蛻殼可提供製石灰的殼。成體護卵時會攻擊複製人，牧場動線需隔離。

resources.use_en: Used with rust for oxygen, crushed into table salt for morale, and involved in saline processing. Desalinators provide a renewable stream when salt water or brine is renewable.
resources.use_zh: 可與鐵鏽製氧，也可磨成食鹽提高士氣，並參與鹽水加工；若鹽水或濃鹽水可再生，淡化器能持續產鹽。

resources.use_en: Desalinate into water and salt and use directly for Waterweed or compatible Aquatic crops. Pumping and desalination add power and heat costs.
resources.use_zh: 可淡化成水與鹽，也可直接供水草或相容水族作物；抽水與淡化會增加耗電及熱量。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
resources.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

entity.use_en: An underwater crop fertilized with bleach stone that yields lettuce for high-quality food. Bleach-stone supply and liquid conditions are the main constraints.
entity.use_zh: 水下作物，以漂白石施肥並產出生菜供高品質料理；漂白石供應與液體環境是主要限制。

resources.use_en: Alloy with tungsten into Thermium for extreme-temperature machinery. It is a rare space material, so bootstrap a renewable Thermium/niobium loop before broad use.
resources.use_zh: 可與鎢製成導熱質，供極端高溫機械；屬稀有太空材料，廣泛使用前宜先建立可再生循環。

resources.use_en: Very high-melting raw mineral for hot-area construction and magma contact. It is not a true insulator, so use insulated tiles or vacuum for heat isolation.
resources.use_zh: 熔點極高，適合高溫區與岩漿接觸建築；並非真正隔熱材，隔熱仍應使用隔熱磚或真空。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Consumed by drillcones and used for high-conductivity Tempshift Plates, Window Tiles and decor. Keep a reserve for space mining.
resources.use_zh: 鑽頭會消耗鑽石，也可製高導熱變溫板、窗戶磚與裝飾品；應為太空採礦保留庫存。

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Build early machinery directly or refine into iron for advanced equipment and steel. Metal Refineries recover more metal than Rock Crushers.
resources.use_zh: 可直接製作早期機械，或精煉成鐵供進階設備與鋼；金屬精煉器的金屬回收率高於碎石機。

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

resources.use_en: A plentiful refined metal for automation, conductive wires and radiation shielding. Its very low melting point makes it unsafe near hot machinery.
resources.use_zh: 常見精煉金屬，適合自動化、導線與輻射屏蔽；熔點極低，不可用於高溫機械附近。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

entity.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.
entity.use_zh:
惡魔花利用它們的花朵引誘沒有戒心的受害者到殭屍孢子雲中。

它們是一種罕見的全寄生植物，它找到哺乳動物宿主感染而不是普通的植物物種。

殭屍孢子最初設計用於藥用目的，但其鎮靜特性從未被提煉到有用的程度。

resources.use_en: Refine into petroleum for power, plastic and rockets, or boil it for higher-yield petroleum. Oil systems produce heat and carbon-heavy byproducts.

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

resources.use_en: Strong raw mineral with a decor bonus, ideal for ladders, tiles and statues in occupied areas. Its thermal conductivity is not insulation-grade.
resources.use_zh: 堅固且有裝飾加成，適合生活區的梯子、磚與雕像；導熱性能不適合作真正隔熱層。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

entity.use_en:
The Jumping Joya is a decorative plant that brings a feeling of calmness and wellbeing to individuals in its vicinity.

Their rounded appendages and eccentrically shaped polyps are a favorite of interior designers looking to offset the rigid straight walls of an institutional setting.

The Jumping Joya's capacity to thrive in many environments and the ease in which they propagate make them the go-to house plant for the lazy gardener.
entity.use_zh:
雀躍掌是一種裝飾植物，能為身處其附近的人帶來平靜與幸福的感覺。

它們圓潤的附肢和奇形怪狀的叢生體是室內設計師的最愛，旨在緩和機構環境中僵硬筆直的牆壁。

雀躍掌適應多種環境的能力，加上其易於繁殖的特性，使其成為懶人園丁的首選盆栽植物。

entity.use_en:
Slicksters are a unique creature most renowned for their ability to exude hydrocarbon waste that is nearly identical in makeup to crude oil.

The two tufts atop a Slickster's head are called rhinophores, and help guide the Slickster toward breathable carbon dioxide.
entity.use_zh:
小油怪是一種獨特的動物，以排放與石油幾乎相同的廢棄物而聞名。

小油怪頭部突出的兩個觸角是化學接收器，幫助找到可呼吸的二氧化碳。

entity.use_en:
Sporechids take advantage of their flower's attractiveness to lure unsuspecting victims into clouds of parasitic Zombie Spores.

They are a rare form of holoparasitic plant which finds mammalian hosts to infect rather than the usual plant species.

The Zombie Spore was originally designed for medicinal purposes but its sedative properties were never refined to the point of usefulness.

resources.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
resources.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

resources.use_en: Warms into carbon dioxide for Slicksters, Oxyferns, Alveo Veras or sterile storage. Sublimation can rapidly raise local gas pressure.
resources.use_zh: 升溫後成為二氧化碳，可供浮油生物、氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈或無菌儲存；昇華可能快速提高局部氣壓。

resources.use_en: A cryogenic chlorine phase that becomes liquid and then gas as it warms. Use only in controlled thermal storage because phase changes can displace mass and damage pipes.
resources.use_zh: 氯的低溫固相，升溫後依序成液體與氣體；只宜在受控熱儲存中使用，以免相變位移物質或損壞管線。

resources.use_en: Enrich for Research Reactor fuel and radbolt production; Beetas can improve the refinement chain. Radiation, nuclear waste and reactor heat require shielding and automation.
resources.use_zh: 可濃縮成研究反應爐燃料並產生輻射粒子；輻射蜂可改善精煉鏈。輻射、核廢料與反應爐熱需屏蔽及自動化。

resources.use_en: Refine into tungsten for high-temperature builds and Thermium production. It is scarce, so avoid ordinary construction uses.
resources.use_zh: 可精煉成鎢，用於高溫建築與導熱質生產；資源稀少，不宜用於一般建築。

entity.name_zh: 輻射蜂（由輻射蜂巢生成）
entity.use_en:
Beetas are insectoid creatures that enjoy a symbiotic relationship with the radioactive environment they thrive in.

Much like the honey bee gathers nectar and processes it to honey, the Beeta turns Uranium Ore into Enriched Uranium through a complex process of isotope separation inside the Beeta Hive.

When first observing the Beeta's enrichment process, many scientists note with surprise just how much more efficient the cooperative combination of insect and hive is when compared to even the most advanced industrial processes.
entity.use_zh:
輻射蜂是一種類昆蟲生物，與牠們賴以生存的放射性環境有著共生關係。

就像蜜蜂採集花蜜並將其加工成蜂蜜一樣，輻射蜂通過輻射蜂巢內複雜的同位素分離過程，將鈾礦轉化成濃縮鈾。

當第一次觀察輻射蜂的濃縮過程時，許多科學家驚訝地注意到，即使與最先進的工業流程相比，昆蟲與蜂巢的結合工作效率也要高的多。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation or a world feature spawns this critter directly; the game defines no egg for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成或地圖特徵會直接生成此小動物；遊戲沒有為它定義蛋。

When first observing the Beeta's enrichment process, many scientists note with surprise just how much more efficient the cooperative combination of insect and hive is when compared to even the most advanced industrial processes.

resources.use_en: Off-gasses chlorine and fertilizes Waterweed; it also supports sanitation and bleach-stone production chains. Store it in liquid or sealed chlorine to prevent mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散氯氣，也是水草肥料，並用於消毒及漂白石生產鏈。宜浸液或密封於氯氣中，避免逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Kills exposed germs, supports Dasha Saltvines and some ranching chains, and preserves food atmospheres. It is unbreathable and does not disinfect material inside pipes or solid tiles.
resources.use_zh: 可殺死暴露其中的病菌，供沙鹽藤及部分牧場鏈使用，也能作食物保存氣氛。不可呼吸，且不會消毒管內物質或實心磚內部。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Melt for water while absorbing heat; Ice-E Fans provide local cooling. Plan drainage because mined ice loses mass and may melt during transport.
resources.use_zh: 融化可得水並吸熱，也可供冰冷風扇局部降溫。開採會損失質量，運送途中也可能融化，需先規劃排水。

resources.use_en: A cryogenic chlorine phase used mainly for storage or thermal designs before warming back into chlorine gas. It is extremely cold and phase changes can break pipes.
resources.use_zh: 氯的低溫液相，主要用於儲存或熱力設計，升溫後會成氯氣。溫度極低，發生相變時可能損壞管線。

resources.use_en: Feed a Rust Deoxidizer with salt to produce oxygen, chlorine and iron ore. The oxygen chain is finite unless rust is renewed through space or other sources.
resources.use_zh: 與鹽一起供除鏽機，可產生氧氣、氯氣與鐵礦。除非由太空或其他來源補充，這條製氧鏈屬有限資源。

就像蜜蜂採集花蜜並將其加工成蜂蜜一樣，輻射蜂通過輻射蜂巢內複雜的同位素分離過程，將鈾礦轉化成濃縮鈾。

當第一次觀察輻射蜂的濃縮過程時，許多科學家驚訝地注意到，即使與最先進的工業流程相比，昆蟲與蜂巢的結合工作效率也要高的多。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.

resources.use_en:
The Wheezewort is best known for its ability to alter the temperature of its surrounding environment, directly absorbing heat energy to maintain its bodily processes.

This environmental management also serves to enact a type of self-induced hibernation, slowing the Wheezewort's metabolism to require less nutrients over long periods of time.
resources.use_zh:
冰樹以調節環境溫度的能力出名，直接地吸收熱量以維持生命。

這種環境管理也有助於實施一種自我誘導的冬眠，減緩自身的新陳代謝，從而在較長時間內需要更少的營養。

resources.use_zh: 消耗水與光照產出鬃刺莓，可製多種優質料理；照明增加耗電與熱，宜搭配高效率燈具及冷卻。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

resources.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
resources.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

entity.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.
entity.use_zh: 容易栽種的早期作物，消耗泥土並產出米虱；需要複製人勞動且食物品質低，泥土成為瓶頸前應轉型。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.

entity.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.
entity.use_zh: 耐受性高的裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；沒有生產產物，但在適合溫壓範圍內容易維護。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.

resources.use_en: An easy early crop that consumes dirt and yields Meal Lice. It needs duplicant labor and has poor food quality; transition before dirt becomes a bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 容易栽種的早期作物，消耗泥土並產出米虱；需要複製人勞動且食物品質低，泥土成為瓶頸前應轉型。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

entity.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
entity.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Provides light, decor and radiation; eggs and morphs enable radbolt or solar experiments. It needs food and population control to avoid pathfinding and performance costs.
resources.use_zh: 提供光照、裝飾與輻射；蛋與變種可支援輻射粒子或太陽能實驗。需供食並控制數量，避免尋路與效能負擔。

resources.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
resources.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

resources.use_en: Feed an Oxygen Diffuser or Algae Terrarium for early oxygen; Pacu also eat it. It is finite unless renewed through slime or space sources.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣擴散器或藻類箱早期製氧，帕庫也會食用。除非由軟泥或太空來源補充，否則屬有限資源。

entity.use_en: A hardy decorative plant for decor and room bonuses. It has no production output but is easy to maintain within its temperature and pressure range.
entity.use_zh: 耐受性高的裝飾植物，可提升裝飾與房間效果；沒有生產產物，但在適合溫壓範圍內容易維護。

entity.use_en: Consumes water and light to produce Bristle Berries for several quality foods. Lighting adds power and heat, so combine it with efficient lamps and cooling.
entity.use_zh: 消耗水與光照產出鬃刺莓，可製多種優質料理；照明增加耗電與熱，宜搭配高效率燈具及冷卻。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried food source placed by worldgen features. It helps during early exploration but cannot be replanted as a renewable crop.
resources.use_zh: 由世界生成特徵放置的一次性埋藏食物，可協助早期探索，但不能重新種植成可再生農作。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
resources.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

entity.use_en:
The Muckroot is an aggressively invasive yet exceedingly delicate root plant known for its earthy flavor and unusual texture.

It is easy to store and keeps for unusually long periods of time, characteristics that once made it a staple food for explorers on long expeditions.
entity.use_zh:
塊根是一種根莖膨脹但非常脆弱的植物，以其樸實的味道和特別口感而聞名。

它易於儲存，並且可以保存異常長的時間，這使得它曾經成為探險家在長途旅行中的主要食物。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: Fuel for Coal Generators and a kiln input. Hatch ranches can renew it, but generators emit carbon dioxide and substantial heat.
resources.use_zh: 煤炭發電機燃料及窯爐原料；可由哈奇牧場再生，但發電會排放二氧化碳與大量熱。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: The Hatch has no eyes and is completely blind, although a photosensitive patch atop its head is capable of detecting even minor changes in overhead light, making it prefer dark caves and tunnels.
entity.use_zh: 哈奇沒有眼睛，是完全失明的。雖說頭上感光部位可以偵測微量的光線變化，但使其更喜歡待在黑暗的洞穴與通道。

resources.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.

entity.use_en: Consumes refined or raw metal and generates power while sleeping; morphs can provide other gases. Metal cost is high, and exposed conductors must be integrated safely.
entity.use_zh: 食用精煉或原礦金屬，睡眠時發電；變種可提供其他氣體。金屬成本高，外露導體需安全整合。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.

resources.use_zh: 複製人可呼吸，但可能帶有黏液肺病菌及刺激物。可除臭成氧氣與黏土，或在妥善防疫後供帕夫食用。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses polluted oxygen, irrigates several crops and can be sieved into water. Control germs and heat before routing the output to food or oxygen systems.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散汙氧，可灌溉多種作物，也能過濾成水；輸往食物或製氧系統前需處理病菌與熱量。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
resources.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried forage food for early survival in swamp regions. Harvested specimens do not form a scalable crop.
resources.use_zh: 沼澤地區的一次性埋藏覓食糧，適合早期求生；採集後不能形成可擴充農作。

representative.name_zh: 沼澤甜菜植株生成機制

entity.use_en: A one-time buried forage food for early survival in swamp regions. Harvested specimens do not form a scalable crop.
entity.use_zh: 沼澤地區的一次性埋藏覓食糧，適合早期求生；採集後不能形成可擴充農作。

representative.mechanism_en: World generation places this plant directly; the game defines no collectible seed for it.
representative.mechanism_zh: 世界生成會直接放置此植物；遊戲沒有為它定義可收集種子。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried forage food for early survival in swamp regions. Harvested specimens do not form a scalable crop.
resources.use_zh: 沼澤地區的一次性埋藏覓食糧，適合早期求生；採集後不能形成可擴充農作。

resources.use_en: Electrolyze into oxygen and hydrogen, irrigate crops, research and cool machinery. It is central to many loops, so distinguish renewable supply from one-time deposits.
resources.use_zh: 可電解成氧氣與氫氣，也供灌溉、研究及冷卻。水牽涉多條核心循環，應區分可再生供應與一次性礦床。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water to produce Bog Jellies in a warm swamp climate. It is a practical early crop where clean water and cooling are scarce.
entity.use_zh: 在溫暖沼澤氣候中消耗汙水並產出沼澤果凍；缺乏淨水與冷卻時是實用的早期作物。

resources.use_en: Consumes polluted water to produce Bog Jellies in a warm swamp climate. It is a practical early crop where clean water and cooling are scarce.
resources.use_zh: 在溫暖沼澤氣候中消耗汙水並產出沼澤果凍；缺乏淨水與冷卻時是實用的早期作物。

entity.use_en: Consumes polluted water to produce Bog Jellies in a warm swamp climate. It is a practical early crop where clean water and cooling are scarce.
entity.use_zh: 在溫暖沼澤氣候中消耗汙水並產出沼澤果凍；缺乏淨水與冷卻時是實用的早期作物。

resources.use_en: Consumes polluted water to produce Bog Jellies in a warm swamp climate. It is a practical early crop where clean water and cooling are scarce.
resources.use_zh: 在溫暖沼澤氣候中消耗汙水並產出沼澤果凍；缺乏淨水與冷卻時是實用的早期作物。

resources.use_en: Feeds Oxyferns, Alveo Veras and Slicksters, and creates sterile food storage. It is not breathable and settles in low areas; skim or pump excess.
resources.use_zh: 可供氧氣蕨、多孔蘆薈與浮油生物使用，也可形成無菌食物環境。不可呼吸且會沉積低處，過量時需撇除或抽走。

resources.use_en: Refine into cobalt for machinery and heat-transfer construction. Compare its temperature properties with aluminum before committing scarce ore.
resources.use_zh: 可精煉成鈷，供機械與熱傳建築使用；消耗稀有礦石前應與鋁的溫度性能比較。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Mealwood, Sleet Wheat and other crops and feeds Sage Hatches. Compost, mud processing and Pip ranches can replenish it; monitor long-term farm demand.
resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

resources.use_en: Crush into lime, then combine lime with iron and refined carbon to make steel. Fossil deposits are a key early steel bottleneck.
resources.use_zh: 可粉碎成石灰，再與鐵及精煉碳製成鋼；化石礦床常是早期製鋼瓶頸。

entity.use_en: A decorative plant that improves morale through decor but has no harvestable production output.
entity.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_en: A decorative plant that improves morale through decor but has no harvestable production output.
resources.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

entity.use_en: A decorative plant that improves morale through decor but has no harvestable production output.
entity.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_en: A decorative plant that improves morale through decor but has no harvestable production output.
resources.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_en: Process in a Sludge Press into dirt and water, supporting farms and oxygen systems. Automation prevents duplicants from spending excessive labor on hauling.
resources.use_zh: 可在污泥壓榨器分離成泥土與水，支援農業及製氧；自動化可減少複製人大量搬運時間。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

entity.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
entity.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
resources.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

entity.use_en: Consumes refined or raw metal and generates power while sleeping; morphs can provide other gases. Metal cost is high, and exposed conductors must be integrated safely.
entity.use_zh: 食用精煉或原礦金屬，睡眠時發電；變種可提供其他氣體。金屬成本高，外露導體需安全整合。

resources.use_zh: 是米虱木、雪地小麥等作物的肥料，也可餵賢者哈奇。堆肥、泥漿加工及樹鼠牧場可補充，需監控長期農業消耗。

resources.use_en: Consumed by Farm Stations to apply Farmer's Touch and accelerate crop growth. Production costs polluted water, dirt and phosphorite, so boost only worthwhile crops.
resources.use_zh: 農業站會消耗肥料施加「農夫之觸」以加速作物；生產需汙水、泥土與磷礦，宜只強化值得的作物。

entity.use_en: A decorative plant that improves morale through decor but has no harvestable production output.
entity.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_zh: 可藉裝飾改善士氣，但沒有可收穫的生產產物。

resources.use_en: Process in a Sludge Press into dirt and water, supporting farms and oxygen systems. Automation prevents duplicants from spending excessive labor on hauling.
resources.use_zh: 可在污泥壓榨器分離成泥土與水，支援農業及製氧；自動化可減少複製人大量搬運時間。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

entity.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
entity.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Aquatic ranch animal that eats algae or seeds and produces eggs, fillets and polluted dirt. Its cramped reproduction mechanics can provide low-labor food after a breeding pool is established.
resources.use_zh: 水生牧場動物，食用藻類或種子並產蛋、魚肉與汙土；建立繁殖池後可利用擁擠繁殖機制提供低勞力食物。

resources.use_en: Fertilizes Pincha Pepperplants and Wheezeworts, feeds Dreckos, and can become phosphorus for Shine Bug morphs. Ranching provides a renewable source.
resources.use_zh: 可施肥火椒藤與冰樹、餵龍鱗蜥，也能轉為磷以培育發光蟲變種；牧場可提供再生來源。

resources.use_en: Compost into dirt or feed Pokeshell-family critters; otherwise it off-gasses polluted oxygen. Store submerged or at sufficient gas pressure.
resources.use_zh: 可堆肥成泥土，或餵拋殼蟹系生物；否則會逸散汙氧。宜浸液或存於足夠氣壓下。

resources.use_en: Press into polluted water and polluted dirt, both useful but germ- and off-gassing-prone. Enclose the processing and route outputs deliberately.
resources.use_zh: 可壓榨成汙水與汙土，兩者皆有用途但容易帶菌及逸氣；加工區應封閉並明確分流產物。

resources.use_en: Duplicants can breathe it, but it can carry Slimelung and irritants. Deodorize it into clean oxygen and clay, or feed Pufts where disease control is established.
resources.use_zh: 複製人可呼吸，但可能帶有黏液肺病菌及刺激物。可除臭成氧氣與黏土，或在妥善防疫後供帕夫食用。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses polluted oxygen, irrigates several crops and can be sieved into water. Control germs and heat before routing the output to food or oxygen systems.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散汙氧，可灌溉多種作物，也能過濾成水；輸往食物或製氧系統前需處理病菌與熱量。

resources.use_en: Construction mineral that encourages Hatches toward the Stone Hatch morph. It is strategically useful for establishing renewable coal ranches.
resources.use_zh: 可作建材，並促使哈奇轉化為石殼哈奇；建立可再生煤炭牧場時很有戰略價值。

resources.use_en: A one-time buried forage food for early survival in swamp regions. Harvested specimens do not form a scalable crop.
resources.use_zh: 沼澤地區的一次性埋藏覓食糧，適合早期求生；採集後不能形成可擴充農作。

entity.use_en:
The Bliss Burst is a succulent in the genus Haworthia and is a hardy plant well-suited for beginner gardeners.

They require little in the way of upkeep, to the point that the most common cause of death for Bliss Bursts is overwatering from over-eager carers.
entity.use_zh:
天堂草一種十二卷屬的多肉植物，它很強壯，適合初學者種植。

它們幾乎不需要照顧，常見的死因是過度的灌溉。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.

resources.use_en: Common surface and space construction mineral. Use it as expendable bulk material where stronger decor, insulation or conductivity is unnecessary.

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.

entity.use_en:
Spindly Grubfruit Plants have leggy stems that limit the distribution of nutrients and enzymes to the fruit-bearing branch. This results in a reliable but relatively tasteless harvest.

Introducing the Divergent critter species to these plants enable them to develop into Grubfruit Plants with stronger vascular systems and improved fruit.
entity.use_zh:
蕪弱蟲蜜草細長的莖限制了營養物質和酶向結果枝條的分佈。這導致了可靠但相對無味的果實。

將變異蟲引入這些植物附近，可以使其發育成蟲蜜草，具有更強的維管系統與更高品質的果實。

entity.use_en: Divergent is the term for the two different variants of a single Critter species, those being Sweetles and Grubgrubs. While visually very different, one can lay the egg of the other. Both varieties can be found in the Wasteland Biome, along with Spindly Grubfruit Plants.
entity.use_zh: 甜素甲蟲會食用硫並照料蟲果植物，可產生蔗糖與蛋；適合把可再生硫轉成食物及蔗糖火箭燃料。牧場效率取決於植物、溫度與種群管理。

entity.use_en:
The Bliss Burst is a succulent in the genus Haworthia and is a hardy plant well-suited for beginner gardeners.

They require little in the way of upkeep, to the point that the most common cause of death for Bliss Bursts is overwatering from over-eager carers.
entity.use_zh:
天堂草一種十二卷屬的多肉植物，它很強壯，適合初學者種植。

它們幾乎不需要照顧，常見的死因是過度的灌溉。

resources.use_en: A common metal ore for early wires, automation and machinery; refine it into copper when refined-metal recipes or better decor are required.
resources.use_zh: 常見的早期金屬礦，可製電線、自動化與機械；需要精煉金屬配方或較佳裝飾時再精煉成銅。

resources.use_en: Abundant construction mineral and Stone Hatch feed; also a practical pipe and tile material. It is only moderately insulating despite common use in insulated builds.
resources.use_zh: 常見建材，也是石殼哈奇飼料，適合一般管線與磚；雖常用於隔熱建築，但本身僅屬中等隔熱。

resources.use_en: Common surface and space construction mineral. Use it as expendable bulk material where stronger decor, insulation or conductivity is unnecessary.
resources.use_zh: 常見於地表與太空的建築原礦；在不需要高裝飾、隔熱或導熱時可作消耗性大量建材。

resources.use_en: Primary breathable gas for duplicants and some Aquatic systems. Maintain pressure and temperature, and separate it from hydrogen or contaminants when designs depend on pure gas.
resources.use_zh: 複製人的主要可呼吸氣體，也供部分水族系統使用。需維持壓力與溫度；要求純氣時應與氫氣及汙染物分離。

resources.use_en: Off-gasses breathable oxygen and serves as a rocket oxidizer. Store at high gas pressure or submerged to prevent unwanted mass loss.
resources.use_zh: 會逸散可呼吸氧氣，也可作火箭氧化劑；應存於高氣壓或浸液環境，避免非預期逸散損失。

resources.use_en: Filtration medium for Water Sieves and Deodorizers and feedstock for Glass Forges. Secure renewable sand before committing to large polluted-water loops.
resources.use_zh: 水篩與除臭器的過濾介質，也是玻璃熔爐原料；建立大型汙水循環前應先確保可再生沙源。

resources.use_en: Early general-purpose construction mineral and Hatch feed. Use it freely for ladders and tiles, while reserving specialty minerals for thermal jobs.
resources.use_zh: 早期通用建材，也是哈奇飼料；適合梯子與磚，特殊礦物則留給熱能用途。

resources.use_en: Melts into water and provides portable cooling. Its low mass per tile makes it a modest water source; prevent accidental thawing over sensitive machinery.
resources.use_zh: 融化成水並可搬運冷量；單格質量較低，供水量有限，應避免在敏感機械上方意外融化。

entity.use_en:
Spindly Grubfruit Plants have leggy stems that limit the distribution of nutrients and enzymes to the fruit-bearing branch. This results in a reliable but relatively tasteless harvest.

Introducing the Divergent critter species to these plants enable them to develop into Grubfruit Plants with stronger vascular systems and improved fruit.
entity.use_zh:
蕪弱蟲蜜草細長的莖限制了營養物質和酶向結果枝條的分佈。這導致了可靠但相對無味的果實。

將變異蟲引入這些植物附近，可以使其發育成蟲蜜草，具有更強的維管系統與更高品質的果實。
